proposal.description: fault_cause's episode-start snapshot is wired to its own fault_time output instead of the free-running timestamp_ms, a slip between the two adjacent TIMESTAMP_W ports, so the snapshot just reloads the cleared value
proposal.reason: After a fault episode in S_SS or S_RUN, the host reads the FAULT_TIME bytes over SPI and gets 0 instead of the timestamp at which the episode began. The live TIME registers stay correct because reg_file still takes timestamp_ms.
